title: Minor fixes and some code cleanup

texts: Adjusted how long names are displayed on the chat widget.
Break words in the community assets page so they don't go over each other.
Adjusted the rarity icons on top of identity/ego icons so they adjust their size with the identity/ego instead of being a fixed size.
Added a minor message at the start of the chat history of the global chat.
Fixed a bug in the chat widget where it can send messages to the wrong room under certain circumstances
Cleaned up some parts of the code.
